console_errors_note: one favicon.ico 404 logged by the browser itself on every load of this fixture (no favicon file exists); unrelated to the modal/overlay behaviour under test and not attributable to the unit's code changes
conclusion: Independently reproduces the two claims load-bearing for X3/X16/AT-227: (1) a control genuinely covered by an in-page overlay cannot be clicked by a real pointer, confirmed via Playwright's own interception diagnostics, not a heuristic; (2) dismissing the overlay produces a real, verifiable state change (navigation succeeds) rather than merely a visual one. This corroborates the maker's smoke pass on the two hardest-to-fake claims; the crawl-traversal and mutation claims (state graph shape, kill counts) are verified separately via the project's own test suite and scripts/mutation_check.py, re-run independently by the checker.
